mentions.name: Blackbear
mentions.description: This is a local-first, end-to-end encrypted everything app with file editors for notes, documents, sheets, free-hand canvases, and slides, plus a calendar, task system, and a lightweight discovery engine. It includes a BYOK agent system (Pax) supporting OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and local Ollama models, and works in a browser, from the CLI, and from native Mac and Linux apps.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://blackbear.app -- a local first, end-to-end encrypted everything app with file editors for notes, documents, sheets, free-hand canvases, slides, and a whole lot more. Also features a calendar and task system, and a lightweight discovery engine.
